notes: New: INFERNO. A second mode with a clip bank, where a wave of light runs through the depth of each clip on every kick or every bar. Includes a pure depth look, AUDIO DEPTH and its own Syphon output INFERNO Pulse. Also new: Help menu with Copy Diagnostics (Cmd+Option+D), Show Log Files and Restart INFERNO Server.

win.notes: Layout fix: with portrait (9:16) videos the preview no longer pushes the timeline off-screen. New: drag the edges of the side panels to resize them, and drag the bar above the view buttons to make the timeline taller. Double-click a handle to reset.
